context: Ren interviews a factory manager about production.
purpose: Writer interviewing professional; industry vocabulary in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 生産について、教えていただけますか?
lines.en: Could you tell me about production?
lines.style: soft young man voice, warm professional inquiry delivered carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ええ。部品及び完成品を、ここで作ります。
lines.en: Yes — we make parts and finished goods here.
lines.style: measured boss voice, soft warm informative delivery carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一部は、海外でも、購入されるんですか?
lines.en: Is a portion purchased overseas too?
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm professional delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。検査も、すべてここで行います。
lines.en: Yes. We carry out all inspections here too.
lines.style: professional boss voice, soft warm clear delivery carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 製品の表示も、丁寧ですね。
lines.en: The product labeling is meticulous too.
lines.style: soft young man voice, warm appreciative delivery carefully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お客様のため、当然のことです。
lines.en: It's only natural — for our customers.
lines.style: warm boss voice, soft warm humble delivery carefully

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 記事に、しっかり書きます。
lines.style: humble young man voice, soft warm committed delivery carefully
